as_told.title: Edgar Fouché, TR-3A/B and spinning mercury

plain: A man named Edgar Fouché, known as a UFO whistleblower, is said to have known about the TR-3B, a secret flying triangle supposedly built by "reverse engineering," that is, by copying technology recovered from non-human craft. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says Fouché "would come to learn from various friends he knew, including some NSA officials" about it. Michels tells it differently: he says Fouché claimed to have been at Area 51 himself, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and knew of a TR-3A and TR-3B series from the defence company Northrop Grumman that "involves spinning mercury." If true, it would mean the US flies aircraft built from alien technology.
